reading:
Verizon Communications Inc. is a public company trading as VZ, SEC filer CIK 0000732712, with a New York corporate headquarters at 1095 Avenue of the Americas and an operational headquarters in Basking Ridge, New Jersey.

Verizon is not currently a standalone colocation data center operator in the way most other operators in this registry are. It acquired the Terremark data center business in 2011, then sold 29 of those data centers to Equinix for $3.6 billion in a deal that completed in 2017, and separately sold its private cloud and managed hosting businesses to IBM the same year. Facilities that still carry a Verizon operator tag today are more likely to be telecom network or central-office facilities supporting Verizon's own network operations than active third-party colocation space.

The registry here tracks 5 Verizon facilities across four states, Colorado, Minnesota, New Jersey, and Nevada. Because of the 2017 Terremark-to-Equinix sale, any of these facilities that predate 2017 should be checked during this registry's facility-level research phase for a former_operator relationship, since the physical building may now operate under Equinix rather than Verizon, a direct parallel to the CyrusOne-to-DataBank Houston transaction already flagged elsewhere in this registry.
